research_summary: Pep Guardiola emphatically nodded when asked whether Erling Haaland was back fully fit after a knee issue.

sources.title: FPL Gameweek 27 team news: Friday's live injury updates
sources.citation_excerpt: Pep Guardiola gave no verbal confirmation that Erling Haaland would be available but emphatically nodded when asked if he was back fully fit.
sources.claim_text: Erling Haaland was indicated to be fully fit before GW27 after returning to training.
